summary_en: Public tender offer by Sumitomi Mitsui Construction (subsidiary of INFRONEER Holdings) for all ordinary shares of Mitsui Sumitomo Road completed June 2, 2026. Tender settled April 28, 2026; acquired 8,848,998 shares representing 95.38% voting stake; remaining minority shares compulsorily acquired same date under Companies Act Article 179(1); target now wholly-owned subsidiary.
title_en: Completion of Full Subsidiary Acquisition of Mitsui Sumitomo Road Company Limited by Sumitomi Mitsui Construction Company Limited (subsidiary of INFRONEER Holdings Inc.)
translation_en_brief: On June 2, 2026, Sumitomi Mitsui Construction Company Limited (a subsidiary of INFRONEER Holdings Inc.) announced completion of a tender offer for all ordinary shares of Mitsui Sumitomo Road Company Limited and the resulting full subsidiary acquisition of the target. The public tender offer ran from March 10, 2026, with settlement commencing April 28, 2026. Through the tender, Sumitomi Mitsui Construction acquired 8,848,998 shares, representing 95.38% of voting rights. Upon achieving this supermajority stake, the acquirer exercised its statutory right under Japan's Companies Act Article 179(1) to compulsorily acquire the remaining minority shares held by other shareholders (excluding treasury shares and employee stock trusts). All remaining shares were acquired on June 2, 2026, completing the full subsidiary status. The filing states that the combined entity will pursue further integration to maximize operational synergies and optimize resource allocation within the INFRONEER Holdings group.
